info.title: Travel Planning and Booking Platform API
info.description:
Software Project I (Winter 2026) - Milestone 1 backend (NestJS + MongoDB Atlas).

**Authentication:** call `POST /api/auth/login`. The server sets httpOnly `access_token` and `refresh_token` cookies
(ACC-19); Swagger UI sends them automatically on later requests. When the access token expires call `POST /api/auth/refresh`.
A session expires after 30 minutes without authenticated requests (ACC-06).

Every operation summary lists the requirement IDs it satisfies. Lists are paginated with page size 10 (GEN-05).
Errors share one shape: `{ statusCode, error, message, errors?, path, timestamp }`.

password.description: Password must have at least 8 characters, including at least one letter and one digit

newPassword.description: Password must have at least 8 characters, including at least one letter and one digit

phone.description: International format, 7-15 digits with optional leading +

extraBagPrice.description: Price per extra bag (> 0), platform currency

departureLocal.description: Local time at the departure airport

arrivalLocal.description: Local time at the arrival airport

cabins.description: Optional initial cabins (can also be added via POST /flights/:id/cabins)

departureAirport.description: Only while the flight has no bookings (FLT-05)

arrivalAirport.description: Only while the flight has no bookings (FLT-05)

weightKg.description: Bag weight in kg, must not exceed the cabin's maximum weight per bag (FLT-08)

dateOfBirth.description: YYYY-MM-DD; validated against the passenger type (FLT-12 b)

extraBags.description: Optional extra bags, up to the airline's maximum (FLT-19)

returnFlightId.description: Return flight id for a round trip (one booking, two segments, FLT-12 a)

bookingId.description: Id of a Pending Payment flight booking or hotel reservation

paymentMethod.description: Stripe's built-in test payment methods (no card data involved)

countryCode.description: Country code; must match the city

number.description: Room number/name, unique within the hotel

active.description: false = deactivate (excluded from search); rejected if it overlaps active reservations (HTL-06)

rangeId.description: Availability range id (update/remove) or block id (unblock)

from.description: New first night (update) or first blocked night (block)

to.description: New last night (update) or last blocked night (block)

childrenAges.description: Ages of children assigned to this room (0-17)

countries.description: One or more country codes from GET /api/countries

currency.description: Currency of the cost (default: your preferred currency)

cost.description: Non-negative cost or null to clear

dayId.description: Itinerary day id this transport belongs to

tags.description: Up to 5 tags, max 30 characters each (BLG-08)

providerId.description: Airline id (airline moderator) or hotel id (hotel moderator) - exactly one provider

temporaryPassword.description: Temporary password set by the admin; must be changed at first login. Password must have at least 8 characters, including at least one letter and one digit
Temporary password set by the admin. Password must have at least 8 characters, including at least one letter and one digit
